null_tiers.NULL_span: v = sum_i c_i (h_i - h_bar), c ~ N(0, I_n), normalised, drawn on the TRAIN folds only. Supported exactly on the item span, where a fitted difference-in-means direction also lives. Hardest, honest, and...

prereg.effect_size: Delta_AUROC = AUROC_xf - null_span_mean, with a lineage-clustered bootstrap (B=2000, resampling LINEAGES with replacement) 95% CI.
prereg.headline_statistic: SURV(m) = fraction of the 17 checkpoints on which AUROC_xf exceeds that checkpoint's own NULL_span 95th percentile, with a Wilson 95% interval.

survival_bands_over_17_checkpoints.AMBIGUOUS: 10-12/17, reported in that word with the interval

d2b_first_token_bands.CLEAN: delimiter share == 0 (no item opens on a thinking or role delimiter)

d1_verdict_bands.UNDERPOWERED: the D1.6 abliterated-vs-abliterated positive control fails

r1_frozen_prediction.source: registry.py, frozen before any measurement, as integer predicted_gap_rank
r1_frozen_prediction.meaning: rank 1 = SMALLEST held-out-minus-tuned gap (expected to transfer best)
r1_frozen_prediction.test: screen/race.py class_gap_permutation_test(rows, n_perm=10000, seed=SEED), lineage-clustered permutation of the rank labels against corrcoef(rank, gap)
r1_frozen_prediction.honest_note: This frozen ordering is NOT the same claim as the hypothesis's simpler LEVEL-versus-ACROSS-ITEM split. The registry predicts KNOWLEDGE metrics transfer WORST and BEHAVIOUR/STRUCTURE metrics transfer B...

prereg.multiple_comparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg within each declared family of tests; raw p and q reported side by side.
prereg.correlations: Pearson AND Spearman for every correlation, both with Fisher-z CIs (Spearman with the 1.06 variance inflation factor). Beside any correlation at n < 10 the DETECTABLE |rho| at that n is printed.
prereg.resampling_unit: LINEAGE, never the repo. n_lineages printed beside every aggregate.
prereg.selection_discipline: No metric is evaluated on a checkpoint used to choose its layer or threshold. The primary D2 arm uses a fixed depth fraction, so it makes no selection at all.

content_last.note: Harmful vs plain-benign is the UNMATCHED contrast: TF-IDF alone reaches 0.963 on it, so its lexical floor is NOT a floor.

content_first.note: Same contrast at the first generated token.

twin_xstest.note: MATCHED positional twins -- the honest contrast. Lexical floor 0.655.

harm_vs_allbenign.note: Harmful against every benign kind, including the alarming-looking ones.

prereg.d2_scope_selector: registry `inputs` field == 'activations' (direction fitted from labelled items, refusal drive NOT required) plus the weight family via the within-checkpoint bottom-subspace null.

metadata.sealed_respected: The sealed families are Granite and StableLM2 (ibm-granite/granite-3.2-2b-instruct, stabilityai/stablelm-2-1_6b-chat). Neither is harvested, neither carries a DONE marker, and neither appears anywhere...
